title: Collective Incident Pattern: Tenancy - Bengaluru_Bellandur_OuterRingRoad
text:
Legal Saathi Incident Cluster: TENANCY in Bengaluru_Bellandur_OuterRingRoad
Cluster ID: cluster_bengaluru_deposit_withhold_01
Affected Parties Count: 8
Amount Range: 1_to_2_lakh
Incident Summary: Multiple software professionals reported arbitrary 100% deductions of security deposits (averaging Rs. 1,40,000) citing routine painting and unproven wear-and-tear in Bellandur, Bengaluru upon vacating on 1-month notice.
Collective Action Pathways: Joint conciliation representation to Rent Authority / BBMP Ward Legal Cell; Consolidated legal notice on behalf of affected tenants; Model Tenancy Act Section 13(1) invocation (residential deposit capped at 2 months' rent)
Opposing Party Identifier Hash: 91b36712ca0699ab
summary: Multiple software professionals reported arbitrary 100% deductions of security deposits (averaging Rs. 1,40,000) citing routine painting and unproven wear-and-tear in Bellandur, Bengaluru upon vacating on 1-month notice.

title: Collective Incident Pattern: Property - Mumbai_Thane_Ghodbunder
text:
Legal Saathi Incident Cluster: PROPERTY in Mumbai_Thane_Ghodbunder
Cluster ID: cluster_mumbai_rera_delay_01
Affected Parties Count: 14
Amount Range: 50_to_100_lakh
Incident Summary: Group of home-buyers in Ghodbunder Road, Thane facing 42 months possession delay past RERA registered handover date without payment of delayed possession interest.
Collective Action Pathways: Joint complaint under MahaRERA Section 31 for delay interest; Escalation to MahaRERA Conciliation Forum; Alternative demand for full refund with interest if occupancy certificate is refused
Opposing Party Identifier Hash: bb76bc7dd14a7286
summary: Group of home-buyers in Ghodbunder Road, Thane facing 42 months possession delay past RERA registered handover date without payment of delayed possession interest.

title: Collective Incident Pattern: Consumer - Pan_India_ECommerce
text:
Legal Saathi Incident Cluster: CONSUMER in Pan_India_ECommerce
Cluster ID: cluster_ecommerce_refund_denial_01
Affected Parties Count: 22
Amount Range: 25k_to_50k
Incident Summary: Customers across Delhi, Hyderabad, and Pune reporting unilateral order cancellations with payment deducted and unfulfilled refunds exceeding 30 days.
Collective Action Pathways: Class action complaint through Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA); e-Daakhil filing before District Consumer Forum under CPA Section 35; Claim for compensation for unfair trade practice and mental agony
Opposing Party Identifier Hash: d416ca627b524a52
summary: Customers across Delhi, Hyderabad, and Pune reporting unilateral order cancellations with payment deducted and unfulfilled refunds exceeding 30 days.
